title: ICC Orders Taliban Case Separated From Broader Afghanistan Probe Covering US Nationals
detail: International Criminal Court judges ordered the Taliban accountability case to be separated from the broader Afghanistan investigation that also covers US military personnel, in a significant jurisdictional ruling. The split creates a distinct docket focused solely on Taliban conduct, potentially accelerating proceedings against Taliban officials while insulating the broader probe from political pressure related to US liability.

media.caption: ICC judges order Taliban case split from broader Afghanistan probe covering US nationals.
